entities.summary: Al-Hamra Mosque, also known as the Yunus Ibn Matta Mosque, is a Twelver Shi'ite mosque and mausoleum, located in Kufa, in the Najaf Governorate of Iraq. Established in the 7th century CE, it is one of the oldest places of worship in Kufa. The complex also contains a shrine believed to be dedicated to the biblical Jonah.
